usage: 房 (fong2) mainly means 'room', referring to a separate space in a building.
It can be used to specify particular rooms like bedrooms or living rooms when combined with other words.
The word '房' can be used generally when talking about rooms, without specifying which one.
It can also function as a measure word in some contexts, for example, '一房' to mean one room.
In casual speech, '房' is often used alone to ask about or talk about someone's living or sleeping space.
